item.title: Dumped vehicle no tax or insurance CAD no. 7684 4/8/26, 4th August
item.description:
Vehicle was abandoned on yellow line 29/7/26 with damage to front and driver side front wing. A resident called the police and they attended 4/8/26 as alarm was constantly going off. They done to us and confirmed it has no tax or insurance. They said it’s not a police matter to move it and it should be reported to the council. Please arrange for this vehicle to be removed as it is causing problems where it is.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Dobell Road, Eltham
Report on FixMyStreet
